pattern: \[Win32App\]\[ReportingManager\] Execution state for app with id: {GUID} has been updated\. Report delta: \{""EnforcementState"":\{""OldValue"":(?:""(?<from>\w+)""|null),""NewValue"":""(?<to>\w+)""
description: Captures enforcement state transitions via ReportingManager. Only triggers error when 'to' value indicates an error state. OldValue may be the unquoted JSON literal null on the first-ever write of a reporting state — transitions straight from the initial state (e.g. first write directly to an error state) would otherwise be invisible (IME 1.97 audit 2026-08-17).
